agents.description: Evaluates unverified launch disclosures under bounded attention; assumes sampling gaps and no guaranteed liquidity.
agents.goal: Hold zero position and publish risk assessments based on observed peer signals and news.
agents.name: Risk Analyst
agents.role: Cautious community analyst who reviews launch evidence and publishes objective assessments without trading

agents.description: Operates with bounded capital and heuristic reasoning; cannot verify message authenticity or market depth.
agents.goal: Decide whether to hold, buy, sell within position limits, or publish sentiment based on analyst and whale signals.
agents.name: Retail Trader
agents.role: Small retail trader who reviews analyst and whale messages before deciding whether to execute small trades up to their cap

agents.description: Manages larger exploratory allocation under bounded rationality without assuming equilibrium or price impact certainty.
agents.goal: Evaluate whether to hold, buy, sell within allocation limit, or publish signals tracking news and peer messages.
agents.name: Whale Participant
agents.role: Larger trader monitoring news, analyst, and retail messages to evaluate exploratory buys up to their position limit

assumptions: All participant endowments, pool reserves, fees, and launch events are explicit illustrative assumptions approved for this pilot.
NEAR is the scenario network label; this simulation issues no live on-chain transactions.
The 3 slots represent independent role contexts executed by language model prompts, not authenticated human individuals.
Messages published in round one become visible in round two according to subscription links without authenticating external truth.
Agents operate under bounded rationality with limited attention capacity and non-equilibrium heuristics.
Observed trade data and peer messages are unverified signals with potential reporting lags and gaps.
No agent possesses privileged information, calibrated event probabilities, or guaranteed profit paths.
Actions are strictly constrained to predefined action vocabularies, cash limits, and position caps.
event_description: A fictional NEAR memecoin launch tied to a hypothetical Paris political story. Evaluates cash feasibility by testing how an analyst's cautions and trader messages propagate across two interaction rounds. No real-world event, person, contract audit, or resale profit is asserted.

events.provenance: User-supplied public synthetic pilot event; not live news or an on-chain attestation.
events.text: In this fictional world the synthetic pool is open with the stated reserves. A proposed Paris political theme is unverified. No audience demand, real contract audit, KOL endorsement or resale profit is established.
